results.fact: recommended/actual start time from high camp
results.evidence: Confirmed real: turnaround advises leaving high camp 'commonly 4-5am', while timing.recommendedStart and the day-3 schedule start at ~7:00 AM. The one detailed published schedule (2017) broke the col camp in the morning, moved to the glacier bench and began the summit push later, summiting at 6:30 PM and returning after dark; another party (2020) says only that they started early. No source found for a 4-5am norm, and none that recommends 7:00 AM as a start rather than recording one party's camp-move day. No patch.

Two independent documented descents differ: a 2017 party made two double-rope (2x60 m) rappels using a directional to reach the snow finger in one pull, while a 2020 party made three rappels (from the top of the chimney, from a second station to the ledge above the glacier, and one more onto the snow), which this row's own approach variant also describes. descent's '2-3' spans both real counts.

results.fact: this route's own summit location vs the area it's filed under
results.correct_value: Same summit: the main/Middle Gunsight Peak, 8,184-8,198 ft
results.evidence: The standard route climbs the main summit of Gunsight Peak (8,198 ft), the tiny barstool horn; that main summit is the Middle Peak, 'the highest peak in the range, the Middle Gunsight'. A topo-derived list gives Gunsight Peak as 8,184 ft, matching the area's 8,185. So the route's 'Gunsight Peak summit' and the area's 'Middle Peak' are the same summit; the 13 ft elevation difference is within tolerance and the ~100 m pin offset is a coordinate matter out of scope.
